key_insight: P^3-WAM unifies perception, future prediction, and action planning into one world-action model for egocentric dexterous manipulation. It learns not just to understand what the hand is doing, but also to forecast visual outcomes and plan goal-directed motions.
problem_solved: Egocentric dexterous manipulation is hard because models must reason about articulated hand motion, camera movement, and task goals at the same time. This paper tackles the need for a single framework that can both interpret manipulation videos and generate future action-visual trajectories for planning.
method: Perceive mode reconstructs articulated hand motion and camera trajectories from egocentric video.
Predict mode generates visual futures conditioned on prescribed actions.
Plan mode jointly predicts action trajectories and their expected visual consequences from an initial image and goal-conditioned context.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this provides a unified framework for learning perception, forecasting, and control in embodied settings. It can support more capable robotic manipulation systems and improve how models connect vision to action.

paper_title: Perceive, Predict, and Plan: a Unified World Action Model for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation
paper_authors: Zirui Wu, Chen Guo, Tianjian Jiang, Zeren Jiang, Zeming Li
